site.pointClockBody: The countdown belongs to the native side, so a hidden window or a machine that slept does not cheat the session. Start, pause, skip, reset, stop — the tray tooltip stays live.
site.pointTrayBody: Tempura lives in the system tray. Closing the window hides it; quitting is a deliberate choice from the tray or Settings. Launch at login if you want it waiting with the kettle.
site.pointLocalBody: Presets, settings, and history sit in local SQLite under the app data directory. No accounts, no cloud, no sync — MIT licensed, yours to inspect.
site.installLinux: AppImage: chmod +x the file, then run it. Debian: install the .deb. Fedora and openSUSE: the .rpm. You may need FUSE for AppImage.
site.installWindows: SmartScreen may warn on the first run — the build is unsigned. More info → Run anyway, or use the MSI.
site.installMacos: Gatekeeper may block an unsigned app. Right-click the app → Open. Apple Silicon and Intel each have their own disk image.
